source_dataset: EduGuard locked source questions and source-group-held-out BloomShift v4 validation/test partitions

action_verb_revision.note: WH-starting rewrites were reconstructed to begin with target-level action verbs. Existing action-led rewrites were preserved. The supervisor worksheet covers all held-out validation/test records and has blank annotation fields.

notes: v0.1.0 is preserved as the immutable original candidate release.
Validation and test were expanded using the larger, separately source-group-held-out BloomShift v4 partitions: 138 rows each (23 per target Bloom level).
Train rows from the original candidate pool were retained only when their group_id did not occur in either held-out partition.
Target rewrites remain silver synthetic data. Human review is required for semantic preservation, context preservation, Bloom alignment, grammaticality, and pedagogical validity.
The original source question itself may contain malformed or incomplete phrasing; action-verb conversion does not repair the source or certify the rewrite.
